description: This file provides wrapper functions around the configured-binding registry functions, adding a call to ensure builtins are registered before invoking the core functions. It facilitates plugin handling of conversation bindings.

methods.name: export function primeConfiguredBindingRegistry( primeConfiguredBindingRegistry
methods.description: Wrapper function that ensures builtins are registered before calling the core registry prime function.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBindingRecord( resolveConfiguredBindingRecord
methods.description: Wrapper function that ensures builtins are registered before resolving a binding record.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBindingRecordForConversation( resolveConfiguredBindingRecordForConversation
methods.description: Wrapper function that ensures builtins are registered before resolving a binding record for a conversation.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBinding( resolveConfiguredBinding
methods.description: Wrapper function that ensures builtins are registered before resolving a binding.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBindingRecordBySessionKey( resolveConfiguredBindingRecordBySessionKey
methods.description: Wrapper function that ensures builtins are registered before resolving a binding record by session key.
